derivation: Written by applying contract/semantics.md to the recorded frames by hand.
NOT generated by running any binding.
One frame shape, so one rule for every field:
bar_time  = ts_str parsed as America/New_York, converted to UTC, floored
to the minute. Nothing else -- no shift onto a left edge and
no grid alignment. EasyLanguage's Time is the point's CLOSE,
so bar_time is a close time (semantics.md 2).
bar_type / bar_interval / category  = EL's own words, verbatim. No
mapping to a timeframe name, and no combination refused.
o/h/l/c   = Open/High/Low/Close verbatim. On a 1-tick series (bar_type 0)
all four are the same print, and that is a fact worth landing.
el_*      = the five reserved words verbatim (semantics.md 3.4).
bid/ask   = InsideBid/InsideAsk, null where the publisher had none. They
arrive on every point, bars included.
sid and the tick-side ts are per-run and were read from this recording.
ts = the wire's receive clock, landed verbatim as its own field --
the only sub-minute ordering a tick chart's rows have (semantics.md 1).
